observations: Used internal combustion engine with green and black protective paint.
Exhaust manifold and intake manifold are visible.
The engine is resting on a concrete surface.
A watermark 'Nigerian Auto Parts' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: No Korean brand markings or logos are visible on the engine in photo 0.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized, stripped, or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine being turned by hand or a compression test result.

risks.risk: The seller may be selling a used or refurbished engine rather than a new original equipment unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine's VIN plate or a receipt showing the purchase date.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as the alternator, belts, or hoses.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with all accessories attached.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or top).
Video of the engine being cranked to confirm it runs.
Photo of the engine with all accessories (alternator, belts, hoses) attached.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
